Run a composite test suite against a linked plugin:

  Phase 1 — Unit:          go test ./... inside the plugin source
  Phase 2 — Smoke install:  nself plugin install <name> then verify /health
  Phase 3 — Smoke uninstall: nself plugin remove <name> then verify clean state

Use --phase to run only specific phases when iterating:

  nself plugin test myplugin --phase=unit
  nself plugin test myplugin --phase=smoke
  nself plugin test myplugin --phase=both    (default)

Usage:
  nself plugin test <name> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help           help for test
      --host           Run tests in host-process mode instead of container
      --no-cleanup     Skip cleanup after smoke test (useful for debugging)
      --phase string   Test phase to run: unit, smoke, or both (default "both")

Global Flags:
      --json                      Machine-readable output: one JSON document on stdout (see JSON-Output)
      --no-deprecation-warnings   Suppress deprecation warnings (for scripted use)
      --no-monorepo               Disable automatic monorepo backend detection
